concerns.text: T011 implements the watchdog that 'aborts the full sweep-and-analyze workflow' (FR-007/SC-004), but it is ordered AFTER T005, the task that executes the full sweep. As ordered, the ~150-run sweep (T005) runs before the runtime-budget guard that is supposed to bound it exists; T004's timeout only covers the tiny `run-single` run. Move the watchdog/runtime-tracker implementation (T011) before T005, or fold a minimal guard into T005's sweep runner.

T011 is tagged [US1] but placed in Phase 2 after US2 (T005–T006, T010) and US3 (T007–T009) tasks, breaking the user-story grouping: the US1 block (T001–T004) is no longer an independently shippable unit because its FR-007/SC-004 enforcement task is deferred past two other stories. Group T011 with the US1 block (or re-tag it to the story whose workflow it actually guards).
